task.description:
REQUEST
Other

DETAIL
We need some updates made in the Alpha Chicago 26-27 Info Packet: https://alpha.school/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Alpha-Chicago-Info-Packet-2026-2027-CalendarB-3.pdf Please see the following: page 8 for tuition overview, bottom of page should say "Enrollment is open for grades PreK-8!" instead of "Enrollment is open for grades K-8!" Page 14 Learn Life Skills: First paragraph instead of "Test2Pass" it should say "AlphaTest". Page 15 under heading at bottom of page should say "AlphaTest:" instead of "Test2Pass:"
